title: Output capture action
statement: For a deterministic Boolean machine $S$, a nondeterministic Boolean machine $A$, and a Boolean loop flag, define the output action associated to an optional Boolean output $e$ as follows: if $e$ is present, write it to the output and move the associated head right; if it is absent, make no write and leave that head stationary.
